title: CAS Spinlock With Owner Checks
shortDescription: Implement a small spinlock API using an atomic compare-and-swap hook.

templates.notes: Use the compare-and-swap hook for acquisition; direct writes are not atomic.

visibleCases.name: initial state
visibleCases.explanation: Initialization clears both lock state and owner.

visibleCases.name: try lock succeeds
visibleCases.explanation: Acquisition must go through the atomic hook.

visibleCases.name: double lock fails
visibleCases.explanation: A held lock cannot be acquired by another owner.

visibleCases.name: owner unlocks
visibleCases.explanation: Only the owner can release the lock.

hiddenCases.name: owner zero rejected
hiddenCases.explanation: Owner id 0 is reserved for no owner.

hiddenCases.name: cas failure stays unlocked
hiddenCases.explanation: Do not update owner if acquisition fails.

hiddenCases.name: unlock unlocked fails
hiddenCases.explanation: Unlock should not succeed without a held lock.

hiddenCases.name: retry after failed cas
hiddenCases.explanation: Failed attempts must leave the lock reusable.
